title: ComponentConfig
description: How a project declares the components it uses. Components are declared, never discovered: an engine that goes looking for something to satisfy 'content/protobuf' is an engine whose runs are not reproducible (ADR 0013). Where this configuration lives and how it merges with hook configuration is design 2.7's business; this schema owns the component entries. See spec.md §10.

name.description: Must equal the name the component declares in its handshake. Two declared components with the same name is a configuration error, detected at resolution and never at first use (spec.md §2.4).

kind.description: Where the component comes from. Open vocabulary: 'oci' is the distribution model, 'file' is a local .wasm for development, 'subprocess' is the out-of-process escape hatch — a command the engine spawns, speaking the same frames over the protocol's own stdio framing (spec.md §9.3).

reference.description: For 'oci', the artifact reference; for 'file', a path; for 'subprocess', the command the engine spawns.

digest.description: Expected manifest digest, e.g. 'sha256:...'. When present it MUST match before any bytes are instantiated. A tag is a name; a digest is the artifact — CI should pin (spec.md §10.3).

Grants.title: Grants
Grants.description: Deny-by-default sandbox grants, per component. An engine must not grant what a declaration does not list, and must fail the load when a component's imports exceed its grants. Not enforceable for the subprocess binding, which runs with the engine user's authority — spec.md §9.3 says so rather than implying it.

env.description: Environment variable names the component may read. No wildcard in v1.

network.description: Whether outbound sockets are granted at all.

deadline-ms.description: Per-call deadline. The engine bounds every component call in time and surfaces expiry as an error value; a hung component cannot hang a verification (spec.md §3.4, spike 1.4 finding 6).

instances.description: Instance policy. 'per-session' is the default: state isolation between sessions for free. 'per-call' was measured at 5.8 microseconds and a component must behave identically either way.
